entries.question: Booking appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods. Please note that online registration is mandatory for OPD visits.

### **Booking Methods**

**1. Online Portal (ORS)**
*   **Website:** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Register/Login → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Choose Department, Date, and Time slot → Enter patient details → Pay the ₹50 fee online → Download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App (ABHA / Health Care App)**
*   Download the app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register using your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the following format: `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
*   You will receive a booking confirmation via SMS.

**4. On-Site Walk-in**
*   **Required:** Patient's Aadhaar Number and an active mobile number.
*   **Process:** Visit the registration counter → Provide your details → Receive an OTP on your mobile → Pay the ₹50 fee → Collect your physical OPD slip.

### **Important Information**
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip regardless of the booking method.
*   **Timings:** OPD registration counters are open **Mon–Fri (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM)** and **Sat (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM)**. They are closed on Sundays.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral letter for your specific department.
*   **Avoid Delays:** Pre-booking your appointment is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

entries.question: and how many marks are there to get..
entries.answer:
Admission to the BPT course at KGMU is determined by a competitive entrance examination. Because the number of applicants changes every year, there is no fixed "passing mark" that guarantees a seat.

Instead, your admission depends on your **merit rank** compared to other candidates who take the exam that year.

Here is what you should know:

*   **Merit-Based:** You must secure a high rank in the entrance exam to be eligible for counseling. The "cutoff" marks (the minimum score needed to get a seat) are decided after the results are declared, based on the difficulty of the paper and the number of available seats.
*   **Eligibility Criteria:** To even be eligible to apply, you typically need to have passed your 10+2 (Intermediate) examination with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) and meet the minimum percentage requirement set by the university for that specific year (usually 50% for General/OBC and 40-45% for reserved categories, though this can vary).
*   **Where to check:** When the admission brochure is released for the upcoming session, it will contain a specific section on "Eligibility" and "Selection Procedure" which will outline the exact qualifying criteria for that year.

I recommend keeping an eye on the [KGMU Admissions page](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) for the official information brochure, which will be released once the admission process for the next session begins.
